description: Canonical cross-repo registry of public APIs for the BlueEconomy API marketplace. Each entry names the owning repo, classification, version, SLA, and the OpenAPI reference that the runtime catalogue (singlewindow server/marketplace/apiCatalogue.ts) digests (sha256, JCS-canonical) and serves signed under envelope v1.0 (JCS + Ed25519 JWS). Tamper-evidence: any change to a spec invalidates its published digest.

envelope.signature: JWS compact, EdDSA over Ed25519 (RFC 8037), kid=<producer>-<epoch>
envelope.keyPolicy: Signing keys are environment-only (MARKETPLACE_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY / MARKETPLACE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY). Never committed. Deployments without a key serve catalogues honestly marked UNSIGNED_NO_KEY.

apis.title: Operational KPIs — clearance time, lanes, permits, payments, feed freshness
Geo Service — AIS / met-ocean feed status API
Data Platform — KPI publishing and lineage API

onboarding.flow: org registration → sandbox API key issuance (hashed at rest, scoped, rate-limited, revocable) → usage metering per key → production-tier elevation via maker-checker approval
onboarding.sandboxDoctrine: Sandbox keys reach only sandbox-marked upstreams and always carry X-Sandbox: true (blueeconomy-agency-sandbox doctrine). Production keys never see sandbox data.
onboarding.elevationControl: maker-checker: the reviewing administrator must differ from the requesting maker; self-approval is refused.
